title: Concurrency-Aware Process Model Forecasting with Causal Nets
abstract: arXiv:2609.22614v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Process model forecasting (PMF) aims to predict the process model that will characterize a future period, thereby providing a process-level view of how behavior is expected to evolve. Existing PMF methods, however, forecast directly-follows graphs, which cannot explicitly represent concurrency. We extend PMF to causal nets by forecasting time series of relation and binding counts and using these forecasts to reconstruct future process models with AND/XOR semantics. To evaluate the resulting models, we introduce a protocol that accounts for partial traces and constructs the workflow nets required for conformance checking. Experiments on four event logs show that the forecasted models achieve conformance levels close to those of models re-mined from observations in the corresponding future windows. translated_title: 基于因果网的并发感知过程模型预测
translated_abstract: 过程模型预测（PMF）旨在预测将刻画未来时期的过程模型，从而提供关于行为预期演变的过程级视角。然而，现有的PMF方法预测的是直接跟随图，无法显式表示并发性。我们通过预测关系计数和绑定计数的时间序列，并利用这些预测结果重建具有AND/XOR语义的未来过程模型，从而将PMF扩展到因果网。为了评估所得模型，我们引入了一种考虑部分轨迹并构建符合性检查所需工作流网的评估协议。在四个事件日志上的实验表明，预测模型达到的符合性水平接近于从相应未来窗口的观测数据中重新挖掘的模型。预测模型还优于静态发现基线方法，后者虽然在结构稳定的日志上保持了较高的精确度，但表现出显著的精确度损失。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于因果网的并发感知过程模型预测方法，通过预测关系和绑定计数的时间序列重建具有AND/XOR语义的未来过程模型，其符合性水平接近从未来数据重新挖掘的模型，并优于静态发现基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a concurrency-aware process model forecasting method based on causal nets, which forecasts relation and binding count time series to reconstruct future process models with AND/XOR semantics, achieving conformance levels close to re-mined models and outperforming static discovery baselines.
